# Tacoma Baseball

> > Community hub for Tacoma, Washington baseball featuring team directories, local high school programs like Stadium Tigers, and an active phpBB discussion forum.

Tacoma Baseball serves as the central online community for baseball enthusiasts in Tacoma, Washington. The site hosts team information for local programs including Stadium Tigers, Franklin Pierce, Bellarmine, and Wilson, while providing a phpBB3-powered forum for community discussions and local sports coordination.

## Key Topics

- Tacoma Baseball Forum
- Stadium Tigers
- phpBB3 community platform
- Local Tacoma sports
- High school baseball programs
- Franklin Pierce
- Bellarmine
- Wilson
- Heidelberg Field
- BBCode formatting
- Forum registration and posting
- Baseball community discussions
- Chuck Peterson
- Washington state baseball

## Main Community Hub

- [Tacoma Baseball](https://tacomabaseball.com): Homepage for Tacoma baseball teams directory and local sports community
- [Tacoma Baseball Forum - Index page](https://www.tacomabaseball.com/phpBB3/index.php): Main forum index for Tacoma baseball community sports discussions
- [Tacoma Baseball Forum - Index page](https://tacomabaseball.com/phpBB3/index.php): phpBB forum index for Tacoma baseball community sports discussions

## Team Pages

- [Stadium Tigers High School Baseball](http://stadium.tacomabaseball.com/stadium2010/): Stadium Tigers 2010 season page with roster, schedule at Heidelberg Field
